name: England
intro: England arrive as genuine contenders but in an unsettled mood, still chasing a first major trophy since 1966. Thomas Tuchel won a kind-looking qualifying group with a perfect record and no goals conceded, yet friendly defeats and cautious, sideways football have left Wembley crowds restless. His squad gamble prioritises 'chemistry' over reputation — with several big names left at home.
highlights: Harry Kane needs just two goals to equal Gary Lineker's England World Cup record (10), arriving off his best-ever scoring season at Bayern Munich.
A crowded race at No. 10: Jude Bellingham's stop-start club season has opened the door for in-form Aston Villa man Morgan Rogers.
Manchester City's Nico O'Reilly, 21, could finally solve England's long-standing left-back problem.
Big omissions: Cole Palmer, Phil Foden, Trent Alexander-Arnold and Harry Maguire all missed the cut.
Group L opens against Croatia — who knocked England out in the 2018 semi-final — followed by Ghana and Panama.
